correctness.rationale: For any p^a, square-gcd residues are precisely those of even truncated p-valuation. Among r<=p consecutive integers, 0 or 1 is divisible by p, giving (p-r)p^(a-1)+r beta(p^(a-2)) for a>=2, while p^1 requires all units. Among p<r<=2p, exactly 2p-r start classes contain one p-multiple and r-p classes contain two whose difference p forbids simultaneous p^2 divisibility; all 2p-run lengths fail. CRT multiplies exact local factors. The first and second finite differences of W_n count maximal cyclic runs because at least one residue is inadmissible. Direct exact checker independently enumerated 899 moduli, 16077 window checks, 65343 maximal-run comparisons; these are corroborative, not proofs.

evidence: The 2010 generalized totient article gives Schemmel counts for runs of units; its related s-prime case excludes divisibility beyond a fixed p-adic threshold, not all odd valuations.
For modulus 9 and length 2 the classical Schemmel unit-block count is 3 but the square-gcd count is 5.
Costello-Watts arXiv:1209.3464 was withdrawn, and its abstract treats consecutive coprimality with primorials, not square-gcd admissibility.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Schemmel exactly covers the squarefree case, acknowledged as prior. The 2010 generalized-totient article full HTML did not state or imply the required two-piece prime-power correction at arbitrary a, or maximal-run multiplicities. The p-adic even-valuation set is neither the units nor the s-prime set, as the explicit 9-modulus countercomparison shows. Unreadable/withdrawn material carries residual risk rather than a claim of exclusion.

value.rationale: The established square-gcd arithmetic function naturally invites counting adjacent admissible residues and maximal clusters, analogous to Schemmel and Jacobsthal. Exact and sharp formulas for every modulus give a complete nontrivial prime-power correction, distinguishing existing unit-only formulas and revealing the 2p-1 limit with exact maximal-run histogram; this is neither arbitrary finite sampling nor a rebranding of the one-point beta count. Uses are local modeling of consecutive residue constraints; no unproved asymptotic or downstream application is asserted.
